rules.statement: A deed of donation is not valid unless there is proof of acceptance by the donees, and possession alone does not constitute acceptance.
rules.supporting_quote: Where in a partition suit the plaintiff relies on a donation for his title, the burden of proof of his title being upon him, he must prove that the donation was valid by acceptance. Where there was proof only of the presence of the donees at the execution of the deed but there Was no expression of acceptance by the donees, possession of the land has not been established.
